description: This Figshare deposit provides ICP-MS laboratory reports for uranium concentrations in groundwater from twelve borewells at Chintamani village, Karnataka, India. The research team collected samples during August–December 2024, and Eurofins India in Bangalore generated the analytical reports. The public Figshare API identifies a PDF data file and confirms CC BY 4.0, allowing free reuse. The PDF was not downloaded. Concentrations are reported in parts per million and require careful unit conversion before comparison with other sources. The small local sample cannot establish contamination conditions across the wider groundwater system or over a full annual cycle. The measurements can support drinking-water source-quality scenarios or checks on contamination assumptions. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
